metrics.name: field_presence_arc
metrics.notes: Required-field presence on the in-memory transaction object.

metrics.name: independently_verified_arc
metrics.notes: Required-field presence after reloading persisted records and running the in-repository verifier module. The verifier is a separate implementation in this repository, not an external auditor.

metrics.name: audit_reconstruction_completeness
metrics.notes: Headline ARC equals independently_verified_arc from persisted records after the in-repository verifier succeeds.

metrics.name: capture_overhead
metrics.notes: latency_ratio = (T_plane - T_no_audit_workflow) / T_no_audit_workflow; storage_overhead_allocated = (bytes_allocated_plane - bytes_allocated_baseline) / bytes_allocated_baseline; storage_total_allocated = bytes_allocated_plane / bytes_allocated_baseline

metrics.name: storage_overhead
metrics.notes: Allocated files including SQLite page allocation. Relative overhead is (B_plane - B_base) / B_base; total allocated multiplier is B_plane / B_base. Logical serialized bytes are reported separately.

metrics.name: storage_total_allocated
metrics.notes: Allocated file size of the complete plane divided by the unrecorded workflow.

metrics.name: storage_overhead_logical
metrics.notes: UTF-8 octet length of SQLite event and transaction payloads plus protected-content files, excluding page allocation.

metrics.name: storage_total_logical
metrics.notes: UTF-8 logical serialized bytes of the complete plane divided by the unrecorded workflow.

metrics.name: reviewer_task_success
metrics.notes: Not a human-subject usability result; scripted field reconstruction only.

tamper_detection_rate.notes: The mutation suite remains in the single-transaction benchmark.
